### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**3** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **64** of **227** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **9** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2c6b936448dce73bb7a0d07f35bc3db950a48ded` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `db846a11e1090f59cc5b14cc0d83119335666b66` — the merge of head `1999c4c532773b4f320c1e636da12d5192181407` into base `2c6b936448dce73bb7a0d07f35bc3db950a48ded`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin db846a11e1090f59cc5b14cc0d83119335666b66 && git checkout db846a11e1090f59cc5b14cc0d83119335666b66
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 2c6b936448dce73bb7a0d07f35bc3db950a48ded 1999c4c532773b4f320c1e636da12d5192181407 && git checkout -B drift-repro 2c6b936448dce73bb7a0d07f35bc3db950a48ded && git merge --no-ff 1999c4c532773b4f320c1e636da12d5192181407

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2c6b936448dce73bb7a0d07f35bc3db950a48ded
```

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1999c4c532773b4f320c1e636da12d5192181407`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts, packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-select-empty-source-31550.test.ts + packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.types.ts, packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts, packages/services/service-settings/src/localization-locale-options.ts, packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service-plugin.ts, packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/localization.manifest.ts, packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-key-options.ts, packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts, packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.ts, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, AGENTS.md (all read, not reviewed). Prose face outside ④: the changeset.

Inputs: card #31550 (body, claim 6722905380, os-dev-report 6723408678), PR #31569 (body, 3-file list, net diff vs `origin/main` at the head), the 48 check-runs on the head (35 success, 13 skipped, none failed or pending; `Check Changeset`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, all 8 `Test Core` shards, every type-check lane green), and the records the card cites (6722607950 on PR #31539, Finding 1 and its observation; 6722247790 on #31422).

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set, select / radio / multiselect, both doors — narrowed, right.** `optionTableOf` already reports `sourced` (#31539). `validatePatch`'s option-bearing branch and `effectiveEnvOverride`'s option family now gate on `sourced || allowed.length greater than 0` and judge through the table's own `judge`. For a sourced table that is `answer.admits`, so the exact change is: a registered source that ANSWERED with no offered options used to be skipped (`allowed.length === 0`), and is now judged by its `admits`. An answer that offers nothing and admits nothing refuses every value: `invalid_option` at the save door, one `error` line and "not in force" at the env door. An answer that offers nothing but admits a value (the second-spelling case `SettingsOptionSourceAnswer.admits` allows) still admits it, so the diff does not refuse blindly on emptiness; it defers to the contract's predicate, and the "offers no value to choose from right now" sentence is picked by `allowed.length === 0` only once `judge` has refused. Right.
- **Declared-table fallback — unchanged, right.** `sourced === false` (no source, or a source that answered `undefined` or threw) keeps the `allowed.length` greater than 0 gate, so a hand-built manifest with no `options` still records nothing to enforce (the `registerManifest` leniency the comment names) and a declared table still judges. Pinned by the two "could not answer" CONTROL rows and the unsourced-key row.
- **Judging order — untouched.** Both doors still judge options → pattern → valueDomain → bounds (→ format/map/json on the env door). A sourced select key that also declares `valueDomain` is still never asked of its source (`!domain` guard, both doors). Pre-existing and unchanged.
- **`multiselect` with `[]`.** `empty` is null/undefined/blank string only, so `[]` enters the branch; the sourced `judge` maps over no elements and refuses nothing, so an empty selection saves under an empty answer. It names no value, which is the one thing the narrowing admits. Consistent.
- **Boot window, env door — the hold holds.** `SettingsServicePlugin.init` calls `holdOptionSourceVerdicts()` before `registerLocalizationLocaleOptions` and before any manifest registers (`settings-service-plugin.ts:244-245`); `start` hooks `kernel:bootstrapped` → `sealOptionSources()` (`:307-309`). In the diff's env branch a sourced refusal while held does NOT `return null`: the `rejected && !this.holdsOptionSourceVerdict(namespace, key)` guard keeps the override in force and remembers the key; `sealOptionSources` re-runs `effectiveEnvOverride` for each remembered key and emits a change for one still refused. `holdsOptionSourceVerdict` is true only for a key with a registered source, so unsourced keys are judged at once as ever. The registration-time audit (`auditEnvOverrides`, `:1447`) excludes sourced option keys, so there is no third judgement point. The dev's claim is verified in the code, and the hold row pins both halves (list fills before the seal → stays in force, nothing said; still empty at the seal → `default`, said once).
- **Boot window, save door — no hold, and no shipped source can reach it.** `validatePatch` has no hold and takes none in this diff. Every shipped `registerOptionSource` call outside tests: `localization-locale-options.ts:165` (`localization.locale`, a `select`) and `objectql/src/plugin.ts:1230-1232` (the three `lifecycle` `map` keys). The map keys are judged by `mapShapeVerdict` under `reg.maps.has(key)`, not by the branches this diff changes. `localizationLocaleOptionSource` reads `offeredCodes(i18n())`, which is `[]` when i18n is absent, has no `getLocales`, or reports an empty or non-array list (`file-i18n-adapter.ts:244` returns the empty loaded set early in the boot), and then `if (codes.length === 0) return undefined` — it answers no answer, never `[]`, so the declared four (`localization.manifest.ts:93-98`) judge and nothing changes for this key while the list is empty. Boot-time saves in the tree (`plugin-auth`: `auth.*`, `localization.timezone`, `localization.currency`; `resetNamespaceRows`: clears, which are `empty` and skipped) touch no sourced select key. I found no shipped source that can answer `[]` at a time a save could happen. The dev's three claims hold.
- **`reportRejectedEnvOverride` dedupe — right for maps, scalars unchanged.** `dedupeAt` is `envName=` plus `stableStringify(offending)` when `offending !== null && typeof offending === 'object'`, else `String(offending)` exactly as before: strings, numbers, booleans, `null` ('null') and `undefined` ('undefined') key as on `main`. `stableStringify` sorts object keys recursively and serialises arrays in order, so two different bad maps under one variable are distinct and the same map with reordered keys is one value (pinned, 3 lines over 4 reads). The only non-map object the reporter can receive is an array under the map branch's `not_a_map` miss, whose key moves from `String(array)` ('a,b') to '["a","b"]'; same dedupe semantics per distinct value. The echo in the line still uses `String(offending)`, but every structured caller passes `shape`, so no `[object Object]` reaches a log line. Right.
- **Public surface — none moved.** `optionTableOf` and `reportRejectedEnvOverride` are private; no export, type, route, schema or manifest changes. The test file uses helpers already on `main` (`lifecycleObjectKeySource`, `lifecycleSettingsManifest`, `LifecycleKeyRegistryLike`).

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/service-settings: patch`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset. Correct against AGENTS.md §3: `(narrowing)` is BREAKING, and "a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition". `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no specifier schema, manifest key or authorable value moves; what narrows is the accept set of a runtime K/V value at the write and env doors.
- Clause-②: `no (narrowing)` holds: nothing widens; the only accept-set movement is the refusal in ①, and the changeset's reach statement (a select-family key whose registered source answered an empty list, saved or in `OS_*`) is the exact set the diff refuses. It also states the hold and the declared fallback correctly.
- **`adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — justified.** The arm is signal (4) of `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` (`breakingDeclaration`), so a disposition is owed and is present, in the same spelling #31539's changeset used. The category's one mechanical refusal is a migration prescription in the body; the body carries none, and `Check Changeset` and `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` are green on the head. On substance: no schema key is added, removed or re-shaped, stored rows are not re-judged (`validatePatch` judges writes only), and the remedy is a value the source offers, so `objectstack migrate meta` has nothing to rewrite. The other categories do not fit (the package publishes; no ADR-0087 registry is in play; no exported symbol moves).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviation: worktree `objectstack-issue-31317` instead of `objectstack-issue-31550`.** Housekeeping on the same claimed branch, cut from fresh `origin/main` after #31539; no effect on the tree. Accepted.
- **Deviation: an own sentence per door for the empty table, and `constraint: { allowed: '' }` on the save refusal.** The sentences are right (the declared-list template would read "must be one of: ."). The constraint is judged in ④ (Finding 1, nit). Accepted as a deviation.
- **`open_questions`: none.** Nothing to escalate.
- **The card's second Task item** ("read the boot hold/seal first; an empty answer during boot must not refuse a locale a later answer would admit; say how the hold covers it") is answered in the PR body and verified in ①: the env door is held and re-judged at the seal; `localization.locale`'s source never answers `[]`.
- **The observation ridden along** (`reportRejectedEnvOverride` dedupe) is in scope by the card's Task and Acceptance and is judged in ①.

### ④ Design judgment

**The narrowing against the published spec on `main`.** `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts:547-556`: "Where a source answers, its options are what a write is judged against and what every manifest read serves ...; the declared `options` are the fallback, standing only while the source has no answer (the system it reads is absent from the composition)." `SettingsOptionSource` (`settings-service.types.ts:535-539`): "The declared table stays the answer whenever the source answers `undefined`." `SettingsOptionSourceAnswer.admits` (`:527-532`): "A value it refuses is answered `invalid_option`, as a value outside a declared table is." An answer of no options is an answer: the running system offers nothing, and its `admits` refuses. On `main` the implementation admitted every value in exactly that state, the one state the spec text does not list as admitting, while the `map` family has judged it since #31422. The diff therefore makes the spec's own refusal real and takes no declared capability away: the declared-table fallback while the source has no answer is intact (`sourced === false`), the hand-built-manifest leniency is intact (same branch), and the `admits` predicate stays the judge, so a source that offers no options but admits a stored spelling still admits it. The spec's "for a `select`, `options` is still required — a dropdown needs something to draw" is about the declaration the parse refuses, not the served answer, and the declaration is untouched.

**Attempts to break it.** (a) Boot ordering on the env door: held from `init` to `kernel:bootstrapped`, re-judged at the seal, change emitted; verified in the diff's guard and in `sealOptionSources`. (b) Boot ordering on the save door: no hold; the only shipped select source answers `undefined` for an empty list, and no boot-time save in the tree touches a sourced select key, so no save can be refused during the window today. (c) A source that answers `[]` early and fills later, env door: the override is held in force and admitted at the seal (pinned); after the seal `effectiveEnvOverride` is re-asked on every `get`, so a refusal is never permanent. (d) Sourced key with a declared `valueDomain`: the source is not consulted at either door; pre-existing, out of this diff's reach. (e) Stored rows: not re-judged; the page source still names a stored value "no longer offered". (f) A source that answers `undefined` during the hold and a declared-table refusal of `OS_LOCALIZATION_LOCALE`: `holdsOptionSourceVerdict` is true because a source is registered, so it is held and re-judged at the seal against the i18n list; pre-existing and preserved. (g) Dedupe over `undefined`-valued object fields would print `undefined` into the key, but `coerceEnvValue` parses JSON and cannot produce one. Nothing found that the diff gets wrong.

**Finding 1 — nit.** On the empty-table refusal the save door emits `constraint: { allowed: '' }`. The empty string is the truthful comma-join of an empty set and matches the documented key, but a client composing its own sentence from `constraint.allowed` (ADR-0114) that splits on `', '` gets one blank option rather than none, and `''` is not distinguishable from "no constraint carried". No effect on correctness or the contract: `code`, `message`, `label` and `value` are right, and the only shipped select source never produces this state. Disposition: accepted deviation, or a follow-up card to spell an empty allowed set as an absent `constraint` (or `[]`) once a client composes from it; not a change to this head.

**Observation, no grade.** The `holdOptionSourceVerdicts` docblock speaks of the `OS_*` door only, and the save door has no hold by design (saves come over HTTP after the boot). A future select source that can answer `[]` during the boot (unlike the locale source, which answers `undefined`) would refuse a save in that window; that is a constraint on the author of such a source, which this PR's body states, not a defect in the tree.

**Observation, no grade.** The dedupe key for an array-valued map miss changes spelling (`String(array)` → serialised form). No shipped reporter relies on the old spelling; the set is private and process-local.

**Tests, as read.** Nine rows over a synthetic `pick_lab` manifest with two sourced keys and one unsourced, sources registered before the manifest so the registration audit leaves them. The two red-on-`main` save rows pin `invalid_option`, the exact sentence and nothing stored for a `select` and a `multiselect`; the env row pins `source: 'default'`, one `error` line naming the variable, `IGNORED` and the empty-table detail; the hold row pins both halves of the seal; the dedupe row pins two different maps said once each and a reordered map said no more, over the real `lifecycleObjectKeySource` and shipped manifest. Three CONTROL rows pin the two things the narrowing must not touch (a source that cannot answer, at each door; an unsourced key) and the recovery (the value saves once offered). Not pinned, and not required by the card: an empty-`options` answer with a permissive `admits`.

## 席位核对

- **形态：** draft，目标 `main`，首行 `Fixes #31550`。`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`、`Metadata-protocol: none` 都在行首，changeset 写明了这次收紧，也带 `adr-0087` 行，写法与已合并的 #31539 相同。
- **契约复审（CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER，收紧面）：** 6723727784 PASS，就在本 head 上。复审代理全程跑在本档，没有回落。
  - 两个门（`validatePatch`、`effectiveEnvOverride`）现在只要来源答复了就判定（`sourced || allowed.length > 0`）。来源答空列表时一律拒绝；来源答空列表但 `admits` 放行时，仍然放行。对照 main 上的 spec，这次收紧是让 spec 自己写明的拒绝真正生效，没有拿走能力。
  - 启动窗口复审逐条核过：
    - `localization.locale` 的来源在没有语言时答 `undefined`，不会答 `[]`；
    - env 门在 hold 期间仍让被拒的覆盖生效，到 seal 时再判定；
    - 已上线的来源里没有能答 `[]` 的 select 来源。
  - 去重改用 `stableStringify`，只作用于对象；标量的去重和以前完全一样。
  - 一条 nit：保存门拒空表时，`constraint.allowed` 是 `''`。接受，不在本 head 改。
- **钉子：** 9 行，main 上 5 行是红的；两个门和去重分别 ablate，分别变红 2、2、1 行。
- **门禁（check-runs @ `1999c4c5`）：** 35 个 success，13 个 skipped，0 个失败。dev 本地 `dispatch-gates --ran` 66/66；service-settings 74 个文件、1416 个测试全部通过。
- **落地条款：** `check-governed-merges --pr 31569`：0 个 governed，+231/−7，走普通队列。席位把它转为 ready 并开启 auto-merge，合并后关闭 #31550。
